# Purpose

Award credit for a correct symmetric overhanging-beam idealization, reactions, piecewise shear and moment functions, diagram construction, minimax derivation, and a support-placement recommendation bounded by the model assumptions.

# Scope of the Base Problem

The base model assumes a straight, uniform, prismatic column under static self-weight, simple point supports, continuous contact, and small deformation. A complete transport design must also evaluate road dynamics, tie-down forces, local bearing and crushing, cracking, lifting history, member orientation, support compliance, trailer flexibility, and applicable safety requirements.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

- context interpretation and load path: 15%;
- idealization and assumptions: 15%;
- reactions and piecewise functions: 30%;
- optimization and diagrams: 30%;
- engineering recommendation and limitations: 10%.
